allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2024-0370: proc-macro-error, a build-time macro dependency of glib-macros, reached only through the GTK3 graph of the Linux build (the GPUI app's WebKitGTK browser); nothing it generates ships on macOS.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2024-0384: instant, behind GPUI Kit (gpui-base, gpui-component); no release replaces it with web-time yet, so it goes when GPUI Kit moves.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2024-0429: Unsound GLib Variant string iterator in glib 0.18, the last GLib that GTK3's bindings take; the Linux build reaches it through GTK3 (the GPUI app's WebKitGTK browser). The fix, glib 0.20, needs GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6. No macOS build links GLib.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2024-0436: paste, a build-time macro, reached through GPUI Kit and Metal in the GPUI app and iroh's Linux network monitor in the core; no release of them drops it yet.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2025-0134: rustls-pemfile, a thin wrapper now archived in favour of rustls-pki-types, reached only through the reqwest fork GPUI Kit's asset loader uses; it goes when that fork moves.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2026-0192: ttf-parser, under fontdb and cosmic-text in the GPUI fork's Linux and web text stack and under usvg; skrifa replaces it once those crates move.
allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2026-0206: rustybuzz, under usvg (resvg) in GPUI Kit and the GPUI fork; harfrust replaces it once usvg moves.

allowedRustWarnings.RUSTSEC-2026-0372: zvariant_derive, merged into zbus 6, reached through zbus 5 in the GPUI app's Linux accessibility (accesskit, atspi) and desktop portals.
